hooks.name: KiroGraph Mark Dirty on Create
hooks.description: Mark the KiroGraph index as dirty when source files are created. Writes the marker directly (same content kirograph's LockManager.markDirty writes, String(Date.now())) instead of spawning node: 4 ms vs 1.18 s per save, measured 2026-10-05.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0; [ -d .kirograph ] && date +%s%3N >.kirograph/dirty 2>/dev/null; exit 0
